_note: VidChain's own generic rules (T8.12, owner decision): addresses that look like a picture, a style sheet, a text or a web page (scripts, fonts and JSON never) but are often a stream playlist. A match never blocks, hides or changes anything: it only lets the re-fetcher read the first bytes, and only #EXTM3U or <MPD makes it a find. Rules are generic path shapes, never a list of sites. path and query are Java regular expressions matched, ignoring case, against the address's path and query.
